dialogues.speaker: Vacarao
dialogues.text: There's been a lot of kuuvahki anomalies in the area lately. Please be careful.

response.speaker: Vacarao
response.text: Yes, I've already handed it over to that gentleman.

response.speaker: Vacarao
response.text: And I heard that not long after, the moment that gentleman tried to take the Slothsheep out of Nod-Krai, it turned into a lifeless seed.

response.speaker: Vacarao
response.text: So his plan to bring it home to his country fell through as well.

response.speaker: Vacarao
response.text: If only he had listened to me, maybe things wouldn't have to end this way.

response.speaker: Vacarao
response.text: All right. Please take care and stay safe.
